regime.label: sticky
regime.ribbon: Net dealer gamma is positive (sticky): a range/pin lean where hedging leans against moves. Positioning, not prophecy.

nodes.note: The largest gamma concentration on the board and the primary pinning zone.
A heavy call-side concentration above spot where upside can slow.
A heavy put-side concentration below spot where the terrain can become slippery.
The estimated boundary between sticky and slippery dealer-gamma terrain.
A secondary concentration where several nearby strikes reinforce one another.
A smaller sticky cluster immediately below spot.
A secondary downside concentration that can matter after the primary floor gives way.
A negative-gamma pocket where a downside move can accelerate.
An upper concentration that can become a new anchor if price accepts above it.
A thin stretch with little gamma friction, where price may travel more freely.

stacks.note: Multiple named structures overlap at this strike, increasing its relevance.

palette_hint.law: Sticky means hedging leans against moves; slippery means hedging can chase them.

source.note: Fixture derived from the public levels.v1 contract for display-path testing.
